punchline: When Brené Brown's husband said "Yeah. Water's good" on their lake swim, he was fighting a panic attack and she was sure he was judging her swimsuit.
thirty_sec: Brené Brown and her husband Steve were swimming across a cove one early morning. Overwhelmed with gratitude, she told him she was glad they were doing this together. He said "Yeah. Water's good" and kept swimming. Embarrassed, she decided he was judging how she looked in her swimsuit. Later Steve told her he had been fighting off a panic attack the whole time.
